name: Afraid Donkey 40
author: radwakhalil22
description: Rounded teal toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: box-shadow becomes 2px 2px 2px 2px #222831, -2px -2px 2px 2px #393E46, -2px 2px 2px 2px #00ADB5, 2px -2px 2px 2px #EEEEEE, transform becomes translateX(1.5em), background-color changes from #ccc to #afa2a2.
